gloss: A country in West Africa. Official name: Republic of Ghana.
Of, from, or pertaining to Ghana or the Ghanaian people.
A person from Ghana or of Ghanaian descent.
The capital city of the province of East Flanders, Belgium.
A minor city in Carroll County, Kentucky.
A minor city in Lyon County, Minnesota.
A town and census-designated place therein, in Columbia County, New York.
An (often walled) area of a city in which Jews are concentrated by force and law. (Used particularly of areas in medieval Italy and in Nazi-controlled Europe.)
An (often impoverished) area of a city inhabited predominantly by members of a specific nationality, ethnicity, or race.
An area in which people who are distinguished by sharing something other than ethnicity concentrate or are concentrated.
An isolated, self-contained, segregated subsection, area or field of interest; often of minority or specialist interest.
A disembodied soul; a soul or spirit of a deceased person; a spirit appearing after death.
A spirit; a human soul.
Any faint shadowy semblance; an unsubstantial image.
A false image, such as in a photographic print or negative, on a television screen, radar display, or telescope, caused by poor or double reception or reflection (from a lens or screen).
Of a disembodied soul: to appear (somewhere or to someone) in the form of an apparition; to haunt.
To imbue (something) with a ghost-like effect or hue.
To continuously cause (someone or something) trouble; specifically, to continuously be in the thoughts of (someone) in a disturbing manner; to perturb, to trouble.
To kill (someone).
A professional writer who is paid to write material that is officially credited to another person; one who writes on behalf of someone else, often for a celebrity.
A demon said to feed on corpses.
A graverobber.
A person with an undue interest in death and corpses, or more generally in things that are revolting and repulsive.
A person with a callous or uncaring attitude to human life and suffering, particularly when prioritizing economic concerns.
A type of clarified butter used in South Asian cooking.
Vegetable oil for cooking.
Like a ghost in appearance; death-like; pale; pallid; dismal.
Horrifyingly shocking.
Extremely bad.
A method of ending a personal relationship by stopping any contact with the other party and not providing an explanation.
The blurry appearance of a television picture resulting from interference caused by multipath reception.
A form of identity theft in which someone steals the identity, and sometimes even the role within society, of a specific dead person (the "ghost") who is not widely known to be deceased.
The phenomenon of the writing on one side of a page in a notebook being partly visible on the other side.
A small cucumber, often pickled whole.
Pickled cucumber regardless of size; a pickle
The penis.
Of or pertaining to ghosts or spirits.
Spooky; frightening.
Relating to the soul; not carnal or secular; spiritual.

A fictitious or erroneous word, originally meaningless (not used in practice), that has been published in a dictionary or similarly authoritative reference work or otherwise listed as genuine, generally as the result of misinterpretation, misreading, or typographical error.

Any undesired image appearing at the image plane of an optical system; either a false image of the desired object, or an out-of-focus image of a bright source of light in the field of the optical system.
A poetic form mostly used for love poetry in Middle Eastern, South, and Central Asian poetry.
To put (someone) in a ghetto, or to isolate as if in a ghetto.
To make (a place) into a ghetto, or to add the characteristics of a ghetto.
A town which has become deserted, usually due to failing economic activity, especially one that still has substantial visible remains.
Anything that has been deserted or abandoned, or has been empty all along.
In the politics of medieval Italian city states, any member of a faction that supported the Holy Roman Emperor in a long struggle against the Guelphs and the Pope.
A fairground attraction in which participants ride through a haunted house in a railcar.

A ghost-themed excursion offered by many tourist railways around the world. Usually, a fictional story is created and performed with static displays or live actors on either side of a train. Actors and actresses play out a story on the long and narrow stage provided by the railcar aisles.
A rail service which does not appear in the public timetables.
A supernatural manifestation of a railway locomotive or passenger cars.
A female given name from French.
A crocodilian of species Gavialis gangeticus, of the family Gavialidae.
A peptide hormone, secreted in the stomach when empty, that increases appetite and secretion of growth hormone from the pituitary gland.
A story about ghosts or the supernatural, often meant to be frightening.
An abandoned ship, or (science fiction, by extension) spaceship, that is haunted and possibly adrift.
Synonym of shadow ship.
The process of becoming a ghetto, an isolated and underprivileged urban area.
The process of ghettoizing (a group): the segregation/isolation of a group and placement of that group into a figurative or literal position of little power.
Northern Albanian, living north of the Shkumbin river, speaker of a Gheg dialect.
Of or pertaining to this people.
The Albanian dialect group spoken by this people.
A person who attempts to track down ghosts.

A fictional ghost in A Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens, who visits Ebenezer Scrooge in order to show him his past, especially certain events of past Christmases that contributed to his later distaste for Christmas.
An evil spirit or monster; a ghoul.
A bicycle painted white and set up as a roadside memorial to indicate where a cyclist was killed by traffic.
An apparent goal where it is not clear whether or not the ball crossed the goal line.
A metaphor for, and criticism of, the Cartesian dualist conception of a human being as a physical body ("the machine") controlled by an immaterial mind ("the ghost").
A apparent intelligence within a machine, computer system, or other technology, as invoked to explain seemingly purposeful actions, mysterious glitches, or unexpected behaviour.
A spirit or alien entity that temporarily inhabits a vehicle, piece of machinery, or computer system.
A traditional Buddhist and Taoist festival in Asia, when ghosts and spirits are said to emerge from the lower realm, and deceased ancestors are venerated.
A surname.
A male given name.
A Bengali who originates from western Bengal.
A surname from Arabic.
A historical region of Albania, land of the Ghegs.
